item.title: Winter racing at Batavia Downs in the balance with board discussion planned this week
item.description: File photo by Howard Owens The future of winter racing at Batavia Downs remains uncertain as the issue heads to the Western Regional Off-Track Betting Corp. Board of Directors meetings on Wednesday and Thursday.Byron Brown, WROTB president and CEO, said the corporation is considering options after horsemen appealed a decision to cancel winter racing for 2026.

item.title: Western Regional OTB CEO signals commitment to Batavia Downs expansion
item.description: Byron Brown speaking on Tuesday at the meeting of the Batavia Rotary Club.Photo by Howard Owens. Western Regional Off-Track Betting Corp. President and CEO Byron Brown highlighted plans to expand the hotel and add a conference and event center at Batavia Downs during a presentation to the Batavia Rotary Club on Tuesday.Brown said the expansion will be the corporation's number one priority in 2026.

item.title: Batavia PBA set to receive raises of 7% as 'one of the city's most critical public safety departments'
item.description: 2025 File Photo of a Batavia Police flag commemoration.Photo by Kara Richenberg Raises of 5% to 7% are in the works for members of the city Police Benevolent Association, after the PBA and city management came to a tentative agreement, City Manager Rachael Tabelski says.Tabelski informed City Council members about the deal during this week’s conference session at City Hall

item.title: OFA to have revised protocols, closed Senior Center Wednesday to Friday due to water outage
item.description: Press ReleaseThe Genesee County Office for the Aging (OFA) is announcing temporary service adjustments following a water outage caused by a sprinkler freeze and burst at the YMCA facility.
